title: CraftMine Challenge
description: Search, Mine, Craft and win together with your friends
body:
# Red vs Blue Mod

**Multiplayer Minigame | Strategic PvP | Custom GUI**  
**Minecraft 1.20.1 | Forge**

**Think fast. Trust no one. Outsmart them all.**  
*Red vs Blue Mod* turns Minecraft into a fast-paced game of strategy, deception, and pressure.  
Perfect for private servers, events, or playing with friends — **every round tells a different story**.

---

## Gameplay

Two teams. One secret item. Limited time.

- 🟥 **Red Team** (1 player)  
  Receives a secret item and a countdown. Craft it, mine it, or find it before time runs out.

- 🟦 **Blue Team** (1+ players)  
  Does not know Red’s objective but will do anything to stop them.

- ✅ **Red wins** if the objective is completed in time  
- ❌ **Blue wins** if Red is blocked or runs out of time

Mind games matter more than combat.

---

## Features

- ✨ **Custom pixel-art GUI**
- 🖱️ **Interactive buttons** (info, settings, team selection)
- 🎨 **Built-in resource pack** with a modern–nostalgic style
- ⏱️ **In-game timer** visible to all players
- ⚙️ **No commands or setup hassle**
- ⚔️ Perfect for custom servers, LAN parties, and content creators

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.20.1**
- Forge
- Multiplayer (**2+ players recommended**)

---

> Created with love by **SeishiroNagi**  
> Inspired by creativity, chaos, and that one time someone crafted the wrong item.
